timing.rule: Round up to whole minutes: 1.25 times the largest cell-specific 95th percentile of complete technical-pilot session durations; at least five complete sessions per cell, all eight cells represented. The pilot is separate from confirmatory data. No decision is automatically submitted.

evidence_coding.adjudication: Third reviewer resolves disagreements after both independent codes are locked; retain originals and adjudicated code. Freeze manual before coding the remaining responses; recode subset if manual changes.
evidence_coding.missing: Missing/blank remains missing; explicit None or non-decisive text is code 0.

C-05: expired certification fails mandatory currency rule
C-06: current AIGP linked to current IAPP membership elsewhere in the file
whole-file reconciliation satisfies the governing requirement

questionnaire.global_scoring: Mean of nonmissing item values after declared reverse scoring. Require ceil(0.8*k) answered items. No item deletion based on observed alpha or treatment separation; no single-item substitution.

PPBE.source: User-supplied literature-grounded adaptation: Hamm et al. (2023); Wang & Benbasat (2016); traceability/inspectability wording grounded in Nauta et al. (2023) and Kulesza et al. (2015).

item_text.PPBE_1: The assistant made clear which evidence its recommendation was based on.
item_text.PPBE_2: I could tell which parts of the source documents the recommendation came from.
item_text.PPBE_3: The evidence behind the recommendation was available for me to examine.
item_text.PPBE_4: The assistant showed enough of its supporting evidence for the recommendation to be checked.
item_text.PPBE_5: It was unclear what evidence the recommendation actually relied on.

ANT.source: User-supplied adaptation: Klein & Martinez (2023), Jensen et al. (2020), Bartneck et al. (2009). Five human-likeness items; no Gefen & Straub social-presence items.

item_text.ANT_1: Using this assistant gives me the feeling of personal communication.
item_text.ANT_4: The assistant communicated with me like a human would.
item_text.ANT_5: The assistant's communication seemed human-like rather than machine-like.

PCE.source: Candidate contextual adaptation: Rotgans and Schmidt (2011); Drosos et al. (2025); Fischer and Schraffenberger (2025). Task-specific independent evaluation wording; not an established cognitive-forcing scale.
PCE.structural_missing_rule: F0: structurally not applicable; never score as zero or compare PCE between forcing conditions.

item_text.PCE_1: Re-entering the role requirements before the AI assessment required me to think carefully about the mandatory requirements.
item_text.PCE_2: Re-entering the role requirements before the AI assessment required me to work out what those requirements meant for screening a candidate.
item_text.PCE_3: Re-entering the role requirements before the AI assessment required me to evaluate the mandatory requirements for myself.

TRUST.source: User-supplied task adaptation: Benbasat & Wang (2005), with Mayer et al. (1995) as theoretical basis. Expertise/ability and integrity-related judgements.

item_text.TRUST_1: This assistant is like a real expert in assessing candidates.
item_text.TRUST_2: This assistant has the expertise to assess candidates accurately.
item_text.TRUST_3: This assistant has the ability to understand the requirements relevant to the assessment.
item_text.TRUST_4: This assistant has good knowledge of the recruitment decision domain.
item_text.TRUST_5: This assistant puts making an accurate assessment first.
item_text.TRUST_6: This assistant keeps a fair assessment in mind.
item_text.TRUST_9: I consider this assistant to possess integrity.

item_text.TRUST_PROPENSITY_1: To what degree do you tend to trust others?

TRUST_PROPENSITY.source: Researcher-supplied single item; no inherited multi-item scale validation claimed.

item_text.LLM_FREQUENCY_1: How frequently do you use AI systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot?

LLM_FREQUENCY.source: Researcher-supplied single item; no inherited multi-item scale validation claimed.

item_text.GENEROSITY_1: I generally try to act generously toward other people.

GENEROSITY.source: Researcher-supplied single item; no inherited multi-item scale validation claimed.

fixed_construct_decisions.explanation_satisfaction: Excluded from main confirmatory battery. If retained, use Hoffman items as an explicitly secondary construct under that name; do not relabel it perceived explainability.
fixed_construct_decisions.PPBE: Replaces old explanation scale; provenance traceability/inspectability, not Hoffman satisfaction.
fixed_construct_decisions.PCE_and_pretrait_status: PCE only F1. Pre-task: LLM use frequency, general interpersonal trust, generosity. Generosity is not risk aversion. NCS6 and risk aversion are not in the agreed active battery.

questionnaire.anchor_confirmation: User confirmed 1–7 Strongly disagree to Strongly agree for PPBE, ANT, TRUST and forcing-only PCE on 2026-10-30. Pre-task response options remain pending.

exclusions.duplicate_rule: One eligible complete linked session per participant; retain earliest created valid session under its original condition, breaking exact time ties by session_id. Resume snapshots of the same session are consolidated using the latest monotonic event sequence. Never select by outcomes or engagement.
required: not in Study 1 or excluded prior sample
frozen material and delivery versions match
prespecified instructed-response item passed once fixed

confidence.control: native select-slider with an unanswered option

evidence_probe.prompt: In a few words, what was the main reason for your final decision?
evidence_probe.interpretation: Post-decision evidence identification, coded using the existing independent-coding plan; not proof of pre-decision verification.
